evidenceSummary.excerpt: Although immortal, the gods were not exempt from physical pain. One day Jupiter suffered intensely from a sudden headache, and, in hopes that some mode of alleviation would be devised, he summoned all the gods to Olympus.
"From his awful head Whom Jove brought forth, in warlike armor drest, Golden, all radiant."
